## [OVERVIEW]

Medusa v2 plugin that extends the native promotion system in three ways: (1) cart-state eligibility rules — subtotal thresholds, item quantities, per-customer usage caps, first-order checks — evaluated dynamically as the cart changes; (2) promotion modes — bundle pricing ("3 for 50") and repeating buy-get deals ("buy 2 get 1 free, every group") that Medusa's one-shot engine cannot express; (3) manual cart adjustments — operator-created discounts/surcharges per cart.

Enforcement uses a three-layer architecture: Layer 1 (Code Gate) validates synchronously when a promo code is entered, Layer 2 (Sync Apply) runs auto-apply evaluation and non-standard adjustment computation synchronously via custom store route overrides and a workflow hook — with an async subscriber fallback for uncovered mutation paths, Layer 3 (Checkout Gate) blocks order placement if any promotion violates its rules.

All plugin-managed promotions must have `is_automatic: false` in Medusa. The plugin owns auto-apply logic via Layer 2.

Four DB tables: `promotion_ext_config`, `promotion_ext_rule_group`, `promotion_ext_rule`, `cart_ext_adjustment`. Admin widgets injected at `promotion.details.after` (rule editor) and `order.details.after` (custom items for order edits).

All four models support arbitrary JSON metadata. A scoped `/v1/cart-adjustments` API provides RBAC-authenticated access via `@retailos-ai/rms-access`. Cart logic functions are barrel-exported via `./cart-logic` for reuse by `rms-cart-orchestrator`.

Temporary feature: `POST /admin/order-edits/:id/custom-items` adds custom line items (title + price, no variant) to orders via the order-edit workflow — a manual workaround for the order-edit promotion gap (custom promotions only recalculate on carts, not order edits).

## [INSTALL]

Requires: Node.js 20+, @medusajs/medusa 2.16.0, PostgreSQL

```bash
yarn add @retailos-ai/rms-promotions-extension
```

Register in `medusa-config.ts`:
```ts
import { defineConfig } from "@medusajs/framework/utils"
export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    { resolve: "@retailos-ai/rms-promotions-extension" },
  ],
})
```

Run migrations:
```bash
npx medusa db:migrate
```

## [QUICKSTART]

```bash
# 1. Create promotion in Medusa admin with is_automatic: false

# 2. Create config with auto-apply
curl -X POST /admin/promotion-ext-configs \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "promotion_id": "promo_abc", "auto_apply": true }'

# 3. Create include rule group
curl -X POST /admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "promotion_config_id": "pec_001", "type": "include" }'

# 4. Add rule: apply when subtotal >= 300
curl -X POST /admin/promotion-ext-rules \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "rule_group_id": "perg_001", "rule_type": "comparison", "config": { "field": "subtotal", "operator": "gte", "value": 300 } }'
```
Promotion auto-applies to carts with subtotal >= 300, auto-removes when below.

## [USAGE]

### Rule Fields

| Field | Type | Operators | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| subtotal | number | eq neq gt gte lt lte | -- | Cart item subtotal pre-discount |
| totalQuantity | number | eq neq gt gte lt lte | -- | Total items in cart |
| quantityOfProduct | number | eq neq gt gte lt lte | { product_id } | Qty of specific product |
| quantityOfCollection | number | eq neq gt gte lt lte | { collection_id } | Qty from specific collection |
| usesPerCustomer | number | lt lte | -- | Times customer used this promotion |
| firstOrder | boolean | eq | -- | Customer has zero prior non-cancelled orders |

Guest carts pass usesPerCustomer and firstOrder unconditionally (optimistic).

### Combinators

rules_combinator on group: "and"|"or" (default "and") — joins rules within a group
include_groups_combinator on config: "and"|"or" (default "or") — joins groups
Defaults produce DNF (Disjunctive Normal Form).

### Auto-Apply vs Code-Only

auto_apply: true — Layer 2 subscriber adds/removes promotion on cart changes
auto_apply: false (default) — code-only, rules enforced on code entry

### Promotion Modes

promotion_mode on PromotionExtConfig controls how discounts are calculated. Non-standard modes reuse Medusa's application_method fields:

| Field | Standard | Bundle | Buy-Get Repeat |
|---|---|---|---|
| type | fixed/percentage | Must be "fixed" | Discount type |
| value | Discount amount/% | Bundle target price | Discount on "get" items |
| max_quantity | Max items discounted | Max participating items (complete bundles only) | Max "buy" items (cycles = floor(max_quantity / buy_quantity)) |

#### Bundle
Fixed price for N qualifying items, repeating. Example: "3 for 50".
Requirements: Medusa promotion "Amount off products" (type: "fixed", target_type: "items")
application_method.value = bundle target price
mode_config = { bundle_size: number, remainder: "full_price" }
IMPORTANT: max_quantity must be >= bundle_size, or null (unlimited). If max_quantity < bundle_size, no bundles can form.

#### Buy-Get Repeat
Buy X at full price, get Y discounted, repeating. Example: "buy 2 get 1 free".
Requirements: product-level type (target_type: "items")
application_method.type = "fixed"|"percentage", application_method.value = discount
mode_config = { buy_quantity: number, get_quantity: number, discount_target: "cheapest", remainder: "full_price" }
IMPORTANT: max_quantity must be >= buy_quantity, or null (unlimited). If max_quantity < buy_quantity, no cycles can form.

Discount applies to cheapest qualifying items. Remainder items at full price.
max_quantity on application_method caps participating items for bundle (only complete bundles form) or "buy" items for buy-get (cycles = floor(max_quantity / buy_quantity)). Note: for buy-get, this counts buy items not discounted items — deliberate business decision diverging from Medusa's native interpretation.

#### Extended Promotion Compatibility
When creating a Medusa promotion for non-standard modes, these settings are required:
- Promotion type: must be "Standard" (not "Buy X Get Y" — incompatible structure, only fires once)
- target_type: "items" (must target individual products)
- Bundle: am.type must be "fixed", am.value must be > 0
- Buy-get: am.type "fixed" or "percentage"
- Allocation: "each" or "once" recommended. "across" works but Medusa forbids max_quantity with it — no quantity cap possible.
- max_quantity: required by Medusa when allocation is "each"/"once". Must be >= bundle_size (bundle) or >= buy_quantity (buyget). Null = unlimited.
- is_automatic: must be false — plugin owns auto-apply logic
- Incompatible types: "Amount off order", "Percentage off order", "Buy X Get Y", "Free shipping"
All constraints validated on create/update (backend HTTP 400 + admin UI toast)

### Manual Cart Adjustments

Operator-created discounts/surcharges per cart. Source: "manual".

```bash
# Item-level discount
curl -X POST /admin/cart-adjustments/:cart_id \
  -d '{ "item_id": "item_abc", "amount": 500, "code": "VIP", "description": "VIP discount" }'

# Cart-wide discount (spread proportionally across items)
curl -X POST /admin/cart-adjustments/:cart_id \
  -d '{ "amount": 1000, "code": "MANUAL", "description": "Store credit" }'
```

Positive amount = discount, negative = surcharge.
Cart-wide adjustments (item_id: null) spread proportionally by item subtotal share.

### Three-Layer Enforcement

| Layer | When | Mechanism | On Failure |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 Code Gate | Promo code entered | updateCartPromotionsWorkflow.hooks.validate (sync) | HTTP 400 |
| 2 Sync Apply | Cart mutation | Custom store route overrides + refreshCartItemsWorkflow.hooks.beforeRefreshingPaymentCollection | Auto-apply + adjustments before response |
| 2b Async Fallback | Cart mutation | cart.updated subscriber (async) | Same as 2, for uncovered paths |
| 3 Checkout | Order placement | completeCartWorkflow.hooks.validate (sync) | HTTP 400 |

### Adjustment Stripping

For non-standard modes, Medusa's computeActions still runs and produces adjustments from the application_method fields. The subscriber strips all Medusa-generated adjustments for these promotions (matched by promotion_id) and replaces them with the plugin's computed adjustments. This stripping is unconditional for any promotion with promotion_mode !== "standard".

## [IMPLEMENT]

### End-to-end: Bundle promotion "2 for 120" via API

When to use: you want N qualifying items to cost a fixed combined price, repeating

Prerequisites:
- Medusa running with the plugin installed and migrations applied
- Admin API access (Bearer token or session)

```bash
# Step 1: Create the Medusa promotion
# type: "fixed", target_type: "items", value: 120 (bundle target price)
# max_quantity: null (unlimited) — or at least >= bundle_size (2)
# is_automatic: false (required)
curl -X POST http://localhost:9000/admin/promotions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "code": "BUNDLE2FOR120",
    "is_automatic": false,
    "type": "standard",
    "status": "active",
    "application_method": {
      "type": "fixed",
      "target_type": "items",
      "value": 120,
      "currency_code": "eur",
      "target_rules": [
        { "attribute": "items.product.id", "operator": "in", "values": ["prod_REPLACE_ME"] }
      ]
    }
  }'
# -> { "promotion": { "id": "promo_abc123", ... } }

# Step 2: Create the ext config with bundle mode
curl -X POST http://localhost:9000/admin/promotion-ext-configs \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "promotion_id": "promo_abc123",
    "auto_apply": true,
    "promotion_mode": "bundle",
    "mode_config": { "bundle_size": 2, "remainder": "full_price" }
  }'
```

Result: cart with 2 qualifying items (65 each, 130 total) gets 10 discount (130 - 120 = 10), total 120.

### End-to-end: Buy-get promotion "buy 2 get 1 free" via API

When to use: buy X at full price, get Y discounted, repeating for every qualifying group

```bash
# Step 1: Create the Medusa promotion
# type: "percentage", target_type: "items", value: 100 (100% off = free)
curl -X POST http://localhost:9000/admin/promotions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "code": "B2G1FREE",
    "is_automatic": false,
    "type": "standard",
    "status": "active",
    "application_method": {
      "type": "percentage",
      "target_type": "items",
      "value": 100,
      "target_rules": [
        { "attribute": "items.product.id", "operator": "in", "values": ["prod_REPLACE_ME"] }
      ]
    }
  }'
# -> { "promotion": { "id": "promo_xyz789", ... } }

# Step 2: Create the ext config with buy-get repeat mode
curl -X POST http://localhost:9000/admin/promotion-ext-configs \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "promotion_id": "promo_xyz789",
    "auto_apply": true,
    "promotion_mode": "buyget_repeat",
    "mode_config": { "buy_quantity": 2, "get_quantity": 1, "discount_target": "cheapest", "remainder": "full_price" }
  }'
```

Result: cart with 3 qualifying items (30 each, 90 total) gets cheapest item free — 30 discount, total 60.

### End-to-end: Bundle promotion via Admin UI

When to use: same as API but configured through the Medusa admin dashboard

1. Go to Promotions -> Create Promotion
2. Set Code (e.g. BUNDLE2FOR120), Status: Active, Is Automatic: off
3. Set Type to "Amount off products", Amount to the bundle target price (e.g. 120)
4. Under Target Rules, add a product rule to scope qualifying products
5. Set Maximum Quantity >= bundle size (e.g. 2+), or leave blank for unlimited
6. Save the promotion
7. Scroll to the "How is the discount applied?" widget
8. Click ... -> Edit, select Bundle Pricing, set Bundle Size to 2, Save

IMPORTANT: If Maximum Quantity < bundle size, no bundles form. The widget shows a red warning when this happens.

### End-to-end: Buy-get promotion via Admin UI

1. Create promotion with Type: "Percentage off product", Percentage: 100 (= free)
2. Set Is Automatic: off, add Target Rules for qualifying products
3. Set Maximum Quantity >= buy quantity (e.g. 2+), or leave blank
4. Save the promotion
5. Scroll to "How is the discount applied?" widget
6. Click ... -> Edit, select Buy-Get Repeat, set Buy: 2, Get: 1, Save

### Adding cart-state rules to a promotion

When to use: you want a promotion to activate/deactivate based on live cart state (subtotal, quantities, customer history)

Prerequisites:
- Medusa promotion exists with is_automatic: false
- Plugin installed and migrations run

```ts
const sdk = /* your Medusa admin SDK instance */

// 1. Create config
const { promotion_ext_config: config } = await sdk.client.fetch(
  "/admin/promotion-ext-configs",
  { method: "POST", body: { promotion_id: "promo_abc", auto_apply: true } }
)

// 2. Create rule group
const { promotion_ext_rule_group: group } = await sdk.client.fetch(
  "/admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups",
  { method: "POST", body: { promotion_config_id: config.id, type: "include", rules_combinator: "and" } }
)

// 3. Create rules: subtotal >= 200 AND totalQuantity >= 3
await sdk.client.fetch("/admin/promotion-ext-rules/batch", {
  method: "POST",
  body: {
    items: [
      { rule_group_id: group.id, rule_type: "comparison", config: { field: "subtotal", operator: "gte", value: 200 } },
      { rule_group_id: group.id, rule_type: "comparison", config: { field: "totalQuantity", operator: "gte", value: 3 } },
    ]
  }
})
```

### Adding cart-state rules via Admin UI

1. Navigate to Promotions -> [your promotion], scroll to "When will this promotion be applied?" widget
2. Click + Add rules or ... -> Edit
3. Toggle Auto Apply on/off
4. Set the group combinator (AND/OR between groups)
5. Add rule group -> configure rules (field, operator, value) inside each group
6. Click Save

### Creating manual cart adjustments from storefront server

When to use: operator needs to apply a custom discount/surcharge to a specific cart

Prerequisites:
- Admin API access (secret token or admin session)
- Cart ID known

```ts
// In your storefront server route handler:
const response = await fetch(`${MEDUSA_URL}/admin/cart-adjustments/${cartId}`, {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": `Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    amount: 1000,           // positive = discount
    code: "OPERATOR_DISC",
    description: "Loyalty discount",
    // item_id: "item_xyz"  // omit for cart-wide spread
  }),
})
```

Conventions:
- All admin endpoints require Medusa admin authentication
- No store-scoped adjustment endpoints exist -- customers must never self-discount
- Adjustments are immediately applied via addLineItemAdjustments, not deferred to cart.updated
- target_rules use Medusa's full-path attribute format: "items.product.id", "items.product.collection_id", etc.

Troubleshooting:
- "mode_config does not match bundle schema": mode_config shape must match the selected promotion_mode
- "Bundle mode requires the promotion type Amount off products": change the Medusa promotion type to "Amount off products" (fixed)
- "Maximum Quantity (N) is less than the bundle size (M)": set max_quantity >= bundle_size or leave unset
- "Maximum Quantity (N) is less than the buy quantity (M)": set max_quantity >= buy_quantity or leave unset
- "Bundle mode requires a positive bundle target price": set application_method.value > 0
- Promotion not auto-applying: check auto_apply is true AND is_automatic is false on the Medusa promotion
- Adjustments disappear after cart update: expected -- the subscriber re-applies from cart_ext_adjustment table on every update
- No bundles forming despite correct config: verify max_quantity >= bundle_size and that target_rules match cart items

### Using the v1 RBAC cart adjustment routes

When to use: you have a non-admin user (e.g. store operator) that needs to manage cart adjustments through RBAC-controlled access instead of full admin auth

Prerequisites:
- @retailos-ai/rms-access configured with RBAC roles
- User has "cart-adjustment" read/create/remove permissions

```bash
# List adjustments (requires "read" permission)
curl -X GET http://localhost:9000/v1/cart-adjustments/:cart_id \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <rbac-user-token>"

# Create adjustment (requires "create" permission)
curl -X POST http://localhost:9000/v1/cart-adjustments/:cart_id \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <rbac-user-token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "amount": 1000, "description": "Operator discount" }'

# Delete adjustment (requires "remove" permission)
curl -X DELETE http://localhost:9000/v1/cart-adjustments/:cart_id/:id \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <rbac-user-token>"
```

### Importing cart logic for external orchestration

When to use: another plugin (e.g. rms-cart-orchestrator) needs to reuse this plugin's cart evaluation and adjustment logic

```ts
import {
  evaluateAutoApplyPromotions,
  computeNonStandardAdjustments,
  recalcStandardAdjustments,
  cartUpdatedHandler,
  validateCartPromotions,
  validateCheckout,
  cleanupCartExtAdjustments,
  enrichCartPromotionsWithAutoApply,
  refetchCart,
  handleAddLineItem,
  handleUpdateLineItem,
  handleDeleteLineItem,
  handleAddPromotions,
  handleRemovePromotions,
} from "@retailos-ai/rms-promotions-extension/cart-logic"
```

These functions are standalone (extracted from subscribers and route overrides) and can be called directly from another plugin's routes or subscribers.

## [CONFIG]

PromotionExtConfig fields:
  promotion_id: string (required) — links to Medusa promotion.id
  auto_apply: boolean (default false) — enables Layer 2 auto-apply
  include_groups_combinator: "and"|"or" (default "or") — joins include groups
  exclude_groups_combinator: "and"|"or" (default "or") — joins exclude groups (draft)
  promotion_mode: "standard"|"bundle"|"buyget_repeat" (default "standard")
  mode_config: JSON (nullable) — shape depends on promotion_mode

Bundle mode_config:
  bundle_size: number (min 2) — items per bundle
  remainder: "full_price" — leftover items at full price

Buy-get repeat mode_config:
  buy_quantity: number (min 1) — items at full price per group
  get_quantity: number (min 1) — items discounted per group
  discount_target: "cheapest" — discount applies to cheapest items
  remainder: "full_price" — leftover items at full price

Reused application_method fields for non-standard modes:
  type: "fixed"|"percentage" — bundle requires "fixed"
  value: number — bundle price (must be > 0) or discount amount/%
  max_quantity: number|null — bundle: >= bundle_size or null; buy-get: >= buy_quantity or null

All four models (PromotionExtConfig, PromotionExtRuleGroup, PromotionExtRule, CartExtAdjustment) accept an optional `metadata: Record<string, unknown>` field for arbitrary JSON.

## [STRUCTURE]

src/admin/components/rules-editor/: Drawer-based rule editor with combinator toggles and group cards
src/admin/components/promotion-mode/: Promotion mode display (read-only with warnings) and edit form
src/admin/hooks/: React Query hooks for configs, rule groups, rules (CRUD + batch)
src/admin/widgets/promotion-rules-widget.tsx: Main widget injected at promotion.details.after
src/admin/lib/types.ts: Admin TypeScript types
src/api/admin/promotion-ext-configs/: Config REST routes, validators, mode validation (cross-validates max_quantity vs bundle_size/buy_quantity)
src/api/admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups/: Rule group REST routes and validators
src/api/admin/promotion-ext-rules/: Rule REST routes and validators
src/api/admin/cart-adjustments/: Manual cart adjustment CRUD per cart
src/api/v1/cart-adjustments/: RBAC-scoped proxy routes for cart adjustments (read, create, delete)
src/api/store/carts/[id]/line-items/route.ts: Override add-item — sync auto-apply + adjustments after workflow
src/api/store/carts/[id]/line-items/[line_id]/route.ts: Override update/delete-item — sync auto-apply + adjustments
src/api/store/carts/[id]/promotions/route.ts: Override promo code entry — sync non-standard adjustments
src/api/store/carts/helpers.ts: Shared refetchCart utility for store route overrides
src/lib/cart-logic-exports.ts: Barrel export of cart logic functions for external consumers
src/lib/cart-route-handlers.ts: Extracted route override logic (add/update/delete item, add/remove promotions)
src/lib/cart-updated-handler.ts: Extracted subscriber logic for cart.updated events
src/lib/rule-evaluator.ts: Pure rule evaluation function (no DB, no side effects)
src/lib/cart-enricher.ts: Builds EnrichedCart context with order history
src/lib/adjustment-calculator.ts: Bundle and buy-get repeat computation
src/lib/target-rule-evaluator.ts: Filters eligible cart items by Medusa target rules (normalizes full-path attributes like "items.product.id")
src/lib/adjustment-spread.ts: Proportional distribution of cart-wide adjustments
src/lib/enrich-cart-promotions.ts: Shared function — attaches auto_apply from promotion_ext_config onto cart.promotions and cart.items[].adjustments[].promotion in-place, for middleware enrichment of store cart responses
src/lib/compute-non-standard-adjustments.ts: Shared function — computes bundle/buyget adjustments, manages ext rows, merges with native adjustments via setLineItemAdjustments. After merging, calls restoreEvictedStandardPromos to recover standard promos removed by Medusa's budget contamination (see ADR-0009). Includes per-cart in-memory lock and ext row dedup. Accepts `insideHook` option to skip updateCartPromotionsWorkflow calls when running inside a workflow hook (prevents deadlock — see ADR-0007). Uses raw promotion code (not prefixed) for adjustments.
src/lib/recalc-standard-adjustments.ts: Corrects native Medusa promotion adjustments after tier repricing. Percentage promos: recalculates amount using repriced unit_price. Fixed promos: caps amount at item subtotal. Must run AFTER repriceCartByQuantityTiers and BEFORE computeNonStandardAdjustments. Only touches native adjustments (promotion_id present, provider_id absent). See ADR-0010.
src/lib/evaluate-auto-apply-promotions.ts: Shared function — evaluates auto_apply configs against cart state, adds/removes promos via updateCartPromotionsWorkflow. Called from route overrides (after lock released) and async subscriber. CANNOT be called from workflow hooks (deadlocks — see ADR-0007).
src/lib/restore-evicted-standard-promos.ts: Detects standard auto-apply promos evicted from cart by Medusa's shared budget contamination, re-links them via remote link module, computes their adjustments independently with a clean context (fresh budget), returns adjustments for merging. See ADR-0009.
src/modules/promotion-ext/models/: MikroORM entities (4 tables)
src/modules/promotion-ext/service.ts: MedusaService with auto-generated CRUD
src/modules/promotion-ext/migrations/: DB migrations
src/subscribers/cart-updated.ts: Layer 2b async fallback — auto-apply + code-applied re-evaluation + adjustment computation
src/subscribers/sync-non-standard-adjustments.ts: Layer 2 workflow hook — computes non-standard adjustments inside refreshCartItemsWorkflow with insideHook: true (no auto-apply — would deadlock)
src/subscribers/validate-cart-promotions.ts: Layer 1 code gate
src/subscribers/validate-checkout.ts: Layer 3 checkout gate
src/subscribers/promotion-deleted.ts: Soft-deletes config/groups/rules on promotion.deleted (workflow hook + event subscriber)
src/subscribers/promotion-restored.ts: Restores soft-deleted config/groups/rules on promotion.restored
src/subscribers/cart-completed.ts: Cleans up cart_ext_adjustment rows when cart completes (order placed)
src/types/: HTTP payload and response TypeScript types
src/types/rbac.ts: RBAC module declarations for @retailos-ai/rms-access
src/workflows/promotion-ext/: Medusa workflows for CRUD operations
docs/metadata-promotion-enforcement/CONTEXT.md: Domain glossary
docs/metadata-promotion-enforcement/adr/: 10 Architecture Decision Records:
  ADR-0001: Three-layer promotion enforcement
  ADR-0002: Plugin-owned auto-promotion engine (not Medusa's is_automatic)
  ADR-0003: Native PromotionRule with setPromotionContext for brand/manufacturer targeting
  ADR-0004: Standard type with value 1 for custom promotion modes (+ limitations discovered: budget contamination)
  ADR-0005: Re-apply after wipe strategy for custom adjustments
  ADR-0006: Serialize applyExtAdjustmentsToCart with in-memory lock
  ADR-0007: Synchronous cart promotion evaluation via route overrides (includes insideHook deadlock fix)
  ADR-0008: Line item adjustment field parity with Medusa (is_tax_inclusive, metadata, code prefix removal)
  ADR-0009: Restore evicted standard promos after budget contamination from non-standard native values
  ADR-0010: Recalculate standard promo adjustments after tier repricing (percentage recalc + fixed-amount capping)

## [API]

POST   /admin/promotion-ext-configs — Create config { promotion_id, auto_apply?, promotion_mode?, mode_config? }
GET    /admin/promotion-ext-configs?promotion_id=X — List configs with nested groups and rules
PATCH  /admin/promotion-ext-configs/:id — Update config fields
DELETE /admin/promotion-ext-configs/:id — Delete config
POST   /admin/promotion-ext-configs/batch — Batch create configs
PATCH  /admin/promotion-ext-configs/batch — Batch update configs
DELETE /admin/promotion-ext-configs/batch — Batch delete configs

POST   /admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups — Create group { promotion_config_id, type, rules_combinator? }
GET    /admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups?promotion_config_id=X — List groups
PATCH  /admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups/:id — Update group
DELETE /admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups/:id — Delete group (cascades rules)
POST   /admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups/batch — Batch create
DELETE /admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups/batch — Batch delete

POST   /admin/promotion-ext-rules — Create rule { rule_group_id, rule_type, config }
GET    /admin/promotion-ext-rules?rule_group_id[]=X — List rules for groups
PATCH  /admin/promotion-ext-rules/:id — Update rule
DELETE /admin/promotion-ext-rules/:id — Delete rule
POST   /admin/promotion-ext-rules/batch — Batch create
PATCH  /admin/promotion-ext-rules/batch — Batch update
DELETE /admin/promotion-ext-rules/batch — Batch delete

POST   /admin/cart-adjustments/:cart_id — Create adjustment { amount, code?, item_id?, description? }
GET    /admin/cart-adjustments/:cart_id — List adjustments for cart
PATCH  /admin/cart-adjustments/:cart_id/:id — Update adjustment
DELETE /admin/cart-adjustments/:cart_id/:id — Delete adjustment
PATCH  /admin/cart-adjustments/:cart_id/batch — Batch update
DELETE /admin/cart-adjustments/:cart_id/batch — Batch delete

POST   /v1/cart-adjustments/:cart_id — Create adjustment (RBAC: create)
GET    /v1/cart-adjustments/:cart_id — List adjustments (RBAC: read)
DELETE /v1/cart-adjustments/:cart_id/:id — Delete adjustment (RBAC: remove)

POST   /admin/order-edits/:id/custom-items — Add custom line item { title, unit_price, quantity } to active order-edit session. Requires unpaid+unfulfilled order. No variant_id needed.

## [DEPS]

@medusajs/framework 2.16.0: Core Medusa framework (modules, workflows, hooks)
@medusajs/medusa 2.16.0: Medusa application server
@medusajs/admin-sdk 2.16.0: Admin widget injection (defineWidgetConfig)
@medusajs/ui 4.1.16: Admin UI components (Drawer, Prompt, Badge, Switch, Tooltip)
@medusajs/icons 2.1.3: Admin icon set
@retailos-ai/rms-medusa-ui ^1.2.3: Custom UI components (RouteFocusModal)
@retailos-ai/rms-access ^1.2.3: RBAC authentication and permission middleware
react 19.0.0: Admin UI rendering
react-hook-form 7.54.2: Form state management in rule editor
@tanstack/react-query 5.64.2: Server state management for admin hooks

## [DEV]

Setup:   yarn install
Test:    yarn test (jest unit tests) | yarn test:integration:modules | yarn test:integration:http
Build:   yarn build (medusa plugin:build)
Dev:     yarn dev (medusa plugin:develop — live reload against local Medusa)
Release: yarn release (changeset publish)
